restorationAuthority: Workspace item identity binds the tab to its task; restore validates live task and project, creates a new human-controlled lifecycle, and never restores targets or approval
hostDecisionAuthority: Only trusted host UI may provide selected local paths or a prepared target tab; no webpage or Agent tool endpoint accepts host decisions

rules.authority: Host binds Agent session to task; model input never grants scope or approval
rules.invalidation: Navigation, DOM change, takeover, cancellation and close invalidate pending targets/results
rules.resume: Only explicit human resume grants Agent control after takeover
rules.profile: Project-isolated browser profiles, independent task tabs
rules.secrets: Do not record typed text or browser credentials in normal task logs
